display_name: LoRa W24 clean U_s 伪标签联合训练（Full 源域）
description: Compare joint PAMF+restorer with and without fixed E104 clean U_s pseudo-label supervision.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA W24 performance goal and user instruction to launch when memory permits.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI pinned W24 archives for fit/inference; Windows phase1-cu128 for independent scoring.
code.cwd: Released archived W24 implementation directory; LoRa experiment files resolved from immutable new release.

data.representation: At fit 8192 complex points; at W24 readout 8 chirps × I/Q × (384 center + 48 native edge).
data.physical_ids_ref: Ordered source V physical IDs and archived blind RX order, 2000 target packets per receiver
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Source only. Real CE labels from L_s. U_s pseudo-labels from unchanged E104 applied only to paired disturbed/restored samples with confidence >= .95. Published U TX labels, source V during fit, and target are unavailable.

checkpoint.initialization: All rows strictly load the source-frozen E104 and fixed 24000-step original-loss U-Net, same data contract, reset optimizer. The auxiliary clean anchor is an unchanged copy of E104.

sources.role: Original E104 PAMF and fixed clean anchor; remains fixed in G-only CE row.
Fixed-step original loss U-Net common initialization.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact W24 E104 contract, source U-Net proof, L_s ID and ten class mapping, U_s metadata without y.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Same original source E104 and fixed U-Net as the true-label joint control, no U TX labels or target. Direct E104 replays the same comparator input.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze exactly at 6000 updates. Reuse same-packet true-label joint baseline predictions. Compare Full 300 source packets independently after freeze. No target prediction for the PL joint arm.

execution.gpu_policy: N607 GPU preference 2,6,5; at least 12 GiB free and fewer than eight visible contexts. Separate from GPUs 3,0,7 occupied by the baseline rows.
execution.stop_rule: Stop dependent phases on illegal roles, missing real smoke, nonfinite/zero gradients, invalid matched source file, or mismatched same-packet direct predictions.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: CPU independent source score after both matched blind prediction matrices are frozen.

rows.method: Joint PAMF and restorer; add confidence-gated E104 clean U_s pseudo CE after recovery
rows.seed_notes: Seed 2026112991 fixes source row ordering and generic perturbations. Source V panel 2026112559. Test waveform stream inherits 2026112207; evaluation identifies W24 E104 model seed. Phase1 has no support or K.
rows.optimizer: AdamW weight decay 1e-4, G lr 8e-5, F lr 3e-5 for enabled groups, cosine eta_min 2e-6, grad clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: Fixed 6000 additional AdamW updates after shared E104 and 24000-step G prior. Both source roles independently sampled each update; exactly 96000 exposures per role.

notes: Same true-label L_s and same unlabeled U_s source sample stream as the separate jointly optimized true-label control, same initial weights, optimizer and 6000-step budget. User specified clean U pseudo labels; U_s metadata must remain without y. Do not use target, source V, practical trace or official data.

Fixed E104 assigns pseudo class only from the clean U_s aperture. Retain confidence >= .95. Apply CE on the same physical packet after independently sampled generic corruption and recovery; weight 1, normalize by all 16 U exposures per step. Stop gradient into E104. Jointly update both restorer and actual PAMF default head, true source CE and waveform/clean anchor losses unchanged.

After freezing, match the 300 Full source physical IDs and the direct E104 decisions to the existing true-label joint run. Append the new row, freeze all predictions and run isolated CPU truth-last. Report pseudo-label count and acceptance, six scenes, low urban, clean and paired transformations.
